Introduction

What is Reiki? In Japanese, the character Rei has many meanings, but the most common are universe, God, and the Absolute. A concept close to Rei, more familiar from Eastern culture and philosophy, is Tao, signifying divine light, a higher law, order, or a kind of ideal standard.
The character Ki means vital energy, life force, the very breath of Life.
Thus, Reiki is most often translated as universal life energy.

The idea is very simple: the whole universe is permeated with Reiki energy, which can be used in simple methods of working with problems of body and soul. The source describes the method as entirely safe: it claims that the body receives exactly as much healing energy as it needs and directs it to the area where it is most needed.

Unlike psychic healing, which is said to require the healer to develop special extrasensory abilities, the source teaches that anyone can use Reiki energy. A person initiated into the Reiki system acts as a channel for this life energy and, according to the tradition, does not expend their own strength; instead, they are said to be strengthened and enriched by it.

Reiki is also presented as one of the oldest forms of healing by laying on hands. According to the account given here, it was known for thousands of years among different peoples. Its practitioners were often venerated as holy embodiments of God. Such holy elders were known in Japan and China, and in Russia they were regarded as saints. The tradition was later almost forgotten, with a revival beginning in the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries.

The source states that Mikao Usui rediscovered this ancient system of Reiki healing in 1922 and named it Usui Reiki Ryoho Gakkai, the Usui Society for the Reiki Healing Method. It says that the society still exists in Japan. At first the school admitted only Japanese students, but later the teaching spread throughout the world. In this telling, it was regarded as a freely received teaching rather than a system owned by a particular author, revealed to Mikao Usui during long meditations at temples on the sacred Mount Kurama. Today, it says, thousands practice Reiki worldwide and millions believe that Reiki helped them recover from illness.

By naming his teaching Usui Reiki Ryoho, Mikao Usui indicated that he was working with the particular aspect of Reiki energy that had been revealed to him. According to the tradition, the teaching passes from Master to student through an initiation: each Reiki Master, originally Usui himself, opens the student's channel and transmits the capacity to work with Reiki energy.
Upon reaching a certain level, a Reiki Master may modify the system in keeping with their own worldview, developing their own methods and skills for working with
the system. The result may be an entirely new practice with its own distinctive energetic qualities.

Thus, after Mikao Usui's death, one of his students, who was a physician, added more medical aspects and modified the Reiki system. This student was Chujiro Hayashi. According to the source, he founded a clinic in the United States, established a society of Reiki followers called Usui Shiho Ryoho, and developed hand positions suited to clinical work, where several healers often worked with the same patient at once.

Today, besides Usui Reiki Ryoho, there are many other practices that draw on Reiki energy. All were created by Reiki Masters. Well-known examples include Tantra Reiki, Kundalini Reiki, and Reiki Yggdrasil. The Reiki Yggdrasil system was introduced to the world by Nikolai Zhuravlev, described here as having practiced methods of exploring and transforming oneself and one's surroundings for more than twenty years.
Why did Nikolai Zhuravlev link Reiki with the concept of Yggdrasil in his distinctive system?

Yggdrasil is the World Tree of Germanic and Norse mythology: an enormous evergreen ash (or yew) steeped in sacred mead, connecting nine worlds, with the destinies of people inscribed upon its leaves. The ancient Scandinavians imagined the whole of existence in the form of this tree.

Yggdrasil is a classic axis mundi, the axis of the world connecting heaven and earth or the underworld, the world of human beings and the world of the gods. This world axis is a cosmic bridge or road between all the worlds.

Yggdrasil literally means the steed or horse of Yggr, one of Odin's names, meaning the Terrible One. The name also alludes to Odin hanging for nine days and nights, pierced by a spear upon the ash tree, to obtain sacred knowledge (in the North, the gallows could be called the 'horse of the hanged'), and to the possibility of traveling from one world to another by means of the Tree. The council of the gods gathered daily beneath the sacred Tree. Its three roots extended into three worlds: Midgard, the world of humans; Jotunheim, the world of frost giants; and Niflheim, the world of the dead and of mist. Three springs rose beside its roots: the spring of fate, the spring of wisdom, and the source of all earthly rivers. Odin gave up his right eye for a drink from the spring and gained inexhaustible wisdom. On the bark of Yggdrasil, Odin revealed the runes to the world in his own blood.

The word runes is connected with the old Germanic root ru or Gothic runa, translated as 'secret' or 'mysterious whisper.' In the ancient world runes were used not only for writing but also for mystical rituals and divination. The tradition holds that people still turn to the mysterious magic of the old runes in pursuit of power, knowledge, and health.

The concept of Rei may likewise be imagined as a Tree, with all that exists forming its branches and the energy of Ki as the life-giving sap nourishing the whole tree from roots to leaves. Rei also symbolizes the human spirit, wisdom, and the ability to become aware and develop. This aspect of the person is regarded as immortal. Ki represents strength, health, and vital potential.

According to this teaching, Reiki helps people harmonize their inner dimensions, soul and body, and their relationships with the world and those around them. What could be more harmonious than a tree—especially the World Tree?

Legend tells that the first human couple came to life from two tree trunks found on a shore. The first man was made from an ash branch and named Ask, meaning 'ash.' The first woman was Embla, a name interpreted here as 'willow' (or, according to other sources, 'alder' or 'elm'). The idea that humans descend from trees was widespread in ancient Europe.

The Tree of Life is the universe in which God dwells. Human beings are themselves miniature Trees of Life and, by reconnecting with the Tree, regain their lost immortality. All negative actions, manifestations, and emotions are said to separate a person from that once-perfect state. The flow of Reiki energy through Yggdrasil is understood as bringing the person back to God. By channeling the energy of the runes, the person makes life more conscious, gains mastery over what happens, and develops more rapidly.

By combining and reworking two ancient teachings—Reiki's life-giving energy and the power of the Scandinavian Tree Yggdrasil—Nikolai Zhuravlev created his own distinctive system of understanding the world, which he called Reiki Yggdrasil.

By attuning to the general flow of the runes, the practitioner is said to gradually feel energy filling body and consciousness, creating a favorable state for self-realization in modern society and the ability to change the surrounding world for the better. The Reiki Yggdrasil system addresses many aspects of life: health, relationships, work, money, experiences and knowledge attributed to past lives, and much more.

Despite its depth, the Reiki Yggdrasil system is presented as accessible to everyone. In the source's metaphor, not only the god Odin but an ordinary person may drink the wisdom of Mimir's spring. The system is described as simple to understand and possible to learn with modest effort.

By gradually becoming aware of the power of Reiki energy (hereafter simply 'the Flow') and understanding the structure of Yggdrasil as the structure of the universe's cosmic consciousness (so that the Flow is part of that structure, while the Tree is itself part of the Flow), the practitioner can ascend, as if on a ladder, through the levels of Reiki Yggdrasil.

The levels of Reiki Yggdrasil. The system includes five basic levels of initiation. After completing all five, the student receives the rank of Reiki Yggdrasil Master. Each level consists of different attunements. An attunement is a particular quality of the Flow, its special frequency. The task is to learn to distinguish these attunements within the general Flow and activate them when needed. The source describes the course as building a powerful framework that projects the Yggdrasil Tree into the body and consciousness, making the practitioner more stable and successful.
The first level includes the following attunements:
• Healing
• Intuition
• Protection
• Working with a Situation

At the first level, you learn skills intended to address common difficulties and thereby improve the quality of your own life and the lives of others. These include practices described as healing and self-healing, the cultivation of intuition, and the ability to protect yourself and others from hostile outside influences.
The second level includes the following attunements:
• Charging an Object
• Activating the Money Flow
• Cleansing People; Cleansing a Room
• Breaking a Connection

At the second level, you learn the practice of charging objects and symbolically cleansing yourself, others, objects, and surrounding space of negative structures. This level also addresses building a healthier relationship with money through the 'money flow' attunement.
The third level includes eight attunements:
• Life Purpose
• Emotion
• Activation
• Power
• Sexuality
• Flight
• Intellect
• Karma

According to the course, the third level helps you recognize your true path and goal in life. It discusses clearing negative information attributed to past incarnations and karmic blocks and finding harmony in your emotional life. It also speaks of becoming more attractive to the opposite sex.
Leadership qualities are activated. The Flight attunement is said to allow consciousness to shift through space and time.
The fourth level includes the following attunements:
• Vision
• Past Lives
• Creating a Situation
• Knowledge
The fourth level is described as activating the third eye (Ajna) and cultivating clairvoyant perception and the ability to create desired situations.
The fifth-level attunements are:
• Connection with the World
• Connection with the Gods

The fifth level is intended to expand consciousness, unite conscious and subconscious awareness, and work with situations on a global level, as well as draw upon the symbolic qualities of the Norse gods.

First Level of the Reiki Yggdrasil System. Receiving the attunements for each successive level takes place at the same time as initiation into Reiki Yggdrasil, which must be conducted by a Master. Sit upright, place your hands palms up, relax as fully as possible, and say: 'I receive the attunements of this Reiki Yggdrasil level from...' followed by the Reiki Yggdrasil Master's name. Initiation transmits knowledge that cannot be conveyed in words or read in a book. Reiki Yggdrasil attunements are passed only from Master to student, from person to person.

Remember that an attunement depends not only on the ritual but on the state of the Teacher or Master, their level of conscious awareness and energetic potential. Thus, the strength of the Flow initially received may differ depending on the Master.
To call upon the Flow, simply say the word 'Yggdrasil' in your mind.

People have different sensitivities and perceptions. Some connect immediately to any Flow and can feel it; for others, the energy of the Flow appears as images. Still others need only know what is happening to them. There is no point in relying on sensations alone. At this moment, deep structures within you are being touched.

When we say 'Yggdrasil,' our consciousness is said to connect to the Reiki Yggdrasil Flow. We then attune to a specific aspect of this energetic Flow. Gradually, with experience, it becomes easier to understand whether the connection to the Flow has occurred.
Attunement: 'Healing'
To receive the first attunement, mentally invoke the Flow with the word 'Yggdrasil,' followed by the name of the attunement: 'Healing.'

This attunement is described as providing comprehensive healing on the physical, psycho-emotional, and energetic levels of a person. We attune to Reiki Yggdrasil. Consciousness connects directly to the system in order to focus the Flow upon a particular person. For this, place your hands on the person's shoulders or head. If that is not possible, for example in distance healing, imagine them resting on your palm or write their name there with your finger.
We do not channel the Flow through ourselves; rather, we place the person we are working with directly into the Flow, attuning them to Reiki Yggdrasil.

The Reiki Yggdrasil system is based on the energy of the runes. According to the manual, working with this energy involves the whole body and all its organs, and healing follows the pattern required by the individual. Rather than treating specific organs, we work with the person as a whole. The person begins to develop an inner structure.
When working on ourselves, we say the attunement name 'Healing,' attune directly to our own body, and observe where the energy goes without interfering with it.

When you work with someone else, although you do not pass the energy of the Flow through yourself, you nevertheless enter the state of the Flow and of that attunement. The author says that if you have an illness, the healing process may also begin for you. The text further claims that recovery can sometimes be accompanied by a temporary aggravation of symptoms, which it describes as not dangerous, and that an illness cannot be transmitted from a patient during an attunement.

The manual recommends activating Healing for yourself no more than once a day, while stating that the practice can be performed for others more frequently. With experience, it says, you will learn to notice what frequency of sessions suits a particular patient: once a day, once a week, or even once a month. It suggests that in some circumstances once a week is sufficient.

The objective is not to feel something extraordinary during the attunement, but to practice the skill. As you work in real situations, you will come to understand the experience and its effects. The manual emphasizes what it regards as the ultimate outcome: the patient's health.
Attunement: 'Intuition'

Intuition is the ability to assess a situation without prolonged reasoning or logical analysis and to make the right decision immediately, finding an answer to any question. It is the direct apprehension of truth without prior logical argument or proof. By activating this attunement, the manual says, you begin to scan your past and future, developing the skill of responding to external signals.

In psychology, intuition is often viewed as one of the leading functions of personality, shaping the person's relationship to self and the surrounding world and their way of making important life decisions.

Intuition is one of the most necessary skills. It saves time and makes life easier, helping you make the right choice in everything from small matters to major situations. Knowing in advance which decision will prove most successful allows you to choose the most suitable course of events.

The Intuition attunement is intended to help you achieve results quickly with minimal expenditure. You learn to understand what is best for yourself and for others, for example in deciding how to help or protect yourself and loved ones.

This attunement should be practiced as frequently as possible so that you become familiar with a sense of inner knowing: what to do, and when. The most important thing is to train every day and put these insights into practice. Bring the use of this 'sixth sense' to the level of a reflex so that you use the attunement not only in the school classroom under the Master's guidance, but everywhere, every day.
To activate the attunement, say 'Yggdrasil' and the name 'Intuition.'

Even if you feel nothing special at first, gradually you will learn to recognize different situations. A sense of the most appropriate way to behave will arise intuitively. The manual says that, as practice develops, this attunement begins activating automatically for students who have completed the training whenever they urgently need to make an important decision.
Attunement: 'Protection'
No one in the modern world needs an explanation of why this attunement is necessary. It concerns not only protection from negative influences but also increasing the density of the energetic body.

When we go outside every day and encounter many people, the teaching recommends making the energetic body, or Cocoon, as dense as possible. This attunement is said to form a projection of Yggdrasil onto the human body and thus produce a healing effect. The source associates almost half of illnesses with dents in the energetic body and claims that Protection restores a person's structure and smooths the energetic Cocoon.
Whenever you find yourself in a crowd, remember to activate this attunement.
Whenever you have to communicate with someone you would rather not speak to, practice Protection.
When you encounter someone who might affect you negatively, remember this attunement, which the author considers essential.

The text maintains that activating the attunement cannot harm anyone because it contains no offensive or combative aspects. It only gently reflects negative influences directed toward you. According to the author, people harm themselves much more when they become emotionally entangled in an unpleasant situation. To activate it, say 'Yggdrasil,' then 'Protection.'

After some time, you can make activating Protection in difficult situations an automatic skill. The author says you may also activate it for relatives to protect them. While at first its effect may last only briefly, with experience you are said to be able to maintain it for longer periods. Above all, try to practice this attunement as often as possible.
Attunement: 'Working with a Situation'

Would you like every life situation and every plan to unfold in the best possible way for you? Of course. But that does not always happen on its own. This is why the Working with a Situation attunement exists. According to the course, activating it brings about the most favorable possible development of events. Simply focus on a particular undertaking, and even a difficult situation is said to resolve in the best way for you.

Be prepared inwardly for the possibility that what you desire may come to you in a completely different way from what you imagined—or may not come at all. The Flow, in this teaching, selects what is truly good and useful for you, allowing an ideal outcome you could not have reached by your own actions. Cosmic energy itself is said to guide you along the right path.
To activate the attunement, say 'Yggdrasil' and 'Working with a Situation,' then try to focus on the situation or task that matters to you.
You do not need to concentrate on one specific situation. You can attune to yourself and to your entire day. The manual suggests that such a day will be more harmonious and emotionally peaceful.

Remember that all Reiki Yggdrasil attunements can be combined. For example, Working with a Situation can be combined with Healing. The source says this allows you to focus not on the whole body but on a particular organ or illness. Its examples are 'Working with a Situation — Healing the Liver' or 'Working with a Situation — Healing a Cold.'

According to the teaching, working on healing through Working with a Situation also addresses the 'situations' associated with the illness, which it describes as the underlying causes. The author says the effects of the Flow thereby become more pronounced than when Healing is used on its own.

In Reiki Yggdrasil, you do not work with your own energy but simply channel the Flow. However, the manual notes that maintaining the Flow still consumes some of your energy. It says using Working with a Situation for healing requires more energy than healing without this attunement.

Practice Working with a Situation as often as possible. The author predicts that you will quickly acquire the skill and that difficulties which once seemed impossible to resolve will become things of the past. Your life will become more harmonious and meaningful.
PRACTICING THE ATTUNEMENTS
The following exercises are recommended for practicing:
1. Attunement: 'Healing'
Find a partner with whom you can practice the Healing attunement regularly, preferably several times a week. Write down which areas of the body respond most strongly to the attunement.
2. Attunement: 'Intuition'

Practice on public transport—for example, which door is best to enter. With a partner, try to guess which hand holds a coin, what image the other person has thought of, and so on. Treat it as a playful exercise, practice constantly, and do not fixate on results! ☺
3. Attunement: 'Protection'

Practice activating this attunement during business communication, while walking in the street, and when interacting with people. Aim to make the desired state activate automatically. Observe when your resourceful state disappears, at what moment, and in connection with what, and then activate the attunement. Also write down the situations in which using it would be most relevant for you.
4. Attunement: 'Working with a Situation'

Write down one or several situations you want to work with. Preferably record or draw the situation on a sheet of paper and hang it on the wall in front of you. Whenever your eyes fall on the image, use the Working with a Situation attunement.
Attunements are best practiced in pairs or groups. I strongly recommend finding a partner and working on the attunements together!
Record your discoveries, achievements, insights, and questions in the Reviews discussion topic.
Good luck! ☺
Second Level of the Reiki Yggdrasil System
Attunement: 'Charging an Object'

The Charging an Object attunement is used when you want to create an object that carries the qualities of the Reiki Yggdrasil Flow. You can charge it with the general Flow or with the energy of a specific attunement. The object is intended to activate your chosen attunement automatically without requiring you to focus constantly on the Flow.
To charge an object, hold it in your hands. If it is very large, simply place your palms on it. Any object can be charged.
To activate the attunement, say 'Yggdrasil' and 'Charging an Object.' You may also add the name of another attunement with which you want to charge the object. Then focus on the object.

Remember that, according to Reiki Yggdrasil teaching, unlike some other practices, the Flow is activated within the object itself, in its inner energetic structure. Therefore try to focus your attention inside the object rather than on its surface.
Even food can be charged. The manual claims that charged food brings a feeling of satiety more quickly than ordinary food and provides additional benefits for the body.
